free_tier.stated: 3 TB / 5 TB / 10 TB / 20 TB / 30 TB tiers under Profi. 3 TB is the value tier: 990 ₽/mo list, 495 ₽/mo when paid annually (50 % annual discount is the steady state, not a short promo. The crossed-out 990 ₽ is the monthly rate). Upload per file: 100 GB. Monthly upload ceiling: 3× your Disk size.

egress.terms: FREE and explicitly unlimited: the plan comparison table states «Неограниченное скачивание по публичным ссылкам» (unlimited downloading via public links) and «Неограниченный доступ по вашим публичным ссылкам». No per-GB egress line exists anywhere in Yandex 360 consumer pricing. You cannot buy extra traffic because none is metered.

tooling: WebDAV endpoint live: `curl https://webdav.yandex.ru/` -> HTTP 302 to auth (expected; the mount is up). rclone `yandex` backend, rclone `webdav` with an app password, alist/OpenList `yandex` driver, official REST Disk API at cloud-api.yandex.net, plus the desktop client for Linux/Windows/macOS.
chaining: Cannot be pooled: one Yandex ID = one Disk. But the Family plan gives 1 TB to each of up to 8 members on one subscription (250 ₽/mo annual ≈ $3.03/TB), which is the cheapest legitimate multiplication path of the storage providers compared. Profi and Family can be stacked. Yandex's own FAQ says the Disk volume sums across two plans on one account.
limits_note: Upload traffic is bounded by terms stating monthly upload limits up to three times disk capacity (9 TB per month upload limit on a 3 TB plan). Per-object upload cap is 100 GB on Profi tiers. Public shared-link downloads are unthrottled and served directly from Yandex edge infrastructure.
reliability_note: Two real risks. (1) PRICE DISCRIMINATION IS DOCUMENTED AND MEASURABLE: the same page carries a «Оплата картой другой страны» (payment by a foreign card) block that routes to a separate tariff sheet, and the USD sheet at 360.yandex.com/premium-plans publishes $12.50/mo for 3 TB Pro versus 495 ₽ (~$5.99) on the RUB sheet. A 2.09× markup for a foreign card. Budget the USD number, not the rouble one. (2) Non-payment locks access progressively and then fully at 44 days (yandex.ru/support/disk/enlarge/disk-space.html). So this is not a set-and-forget archive unless the card keeps working.

extras.limits_verbatim: The binding constraint is the UPLOAD side, not egress: «Месячный лимит загрузки на Диск до 3 объёмов Диска» (3× Disk size per month). On a 3 TB plan that is a 9 TB/month write ceiling — fine for the 20 TiB archive written once, fatal for a churning 10 TiB hot set. Per-object cap 100 GB on Profi. Public-link download is untimed and unthrottled but served from Yandex's own edge, not a CDN you control.

USD sheet (foreign card — the real price): $4.17/TB/mo at 3 TB ($12.50/mo); $4.25/TB/mo at 5 TB ($21.25/mo); $3.17/TB/mo at 1 TB. Family variant: $3.03/TB/mo per member. At 20 TB: not published on either sheet from this session — the 20 TB and 30 TB options exist in the tier selector but render no price without a logged-in account, so no 20 TB figure is claimed.
extras.agent_focus: Wave 7 cheap-PAID lane, regional angle: storage sold in RUB / CNY / BRL / INR / ZAR / TRY / PLN / UAH that never appears on Western price lists. Every paid candidate carries price_per_tb_month at USD-converted list price. FX fixed 2026-10-21 from open.er-api.com: RUB 82.5719/USD, CNY 6.6913, BRL 5.0231, INR 94.9952, ZAR 16.3972, TRY 49.5978, PLN 3.8923, UAH 45.0922, EUR 0.89075/USD. Excluded per brief: AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, IDrive e2. Headline result: the true regional floor with genuinely free egress is ~$2.00/TB/mo (Yandex 360 Profi 3 TB on a Russian card) rising to ~$4.17/TB/mo for the same product bought with a foreign card, and ~$5.95-7.56/TB/mo for flat-rate Western-facing file storage (TheHost, Rollin Host). Everything advertised below ~$2/TB/mo in this set is either capacity-capped, egress-metered, or unverifiable marketing.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
